messages.subject: Conference on Methodology for Clinical Trials in Small Populations and Rare Diseases
parts:
Just curious: is anyone doing any work that relates to the Conference on Methodology for Clinical Trials in Small Populations and Rare Diseases in Warwick in April?  Is anyone presenting there?  I'm guessing that Stan would be a useful tool for that work.  Their InSPiRe project page has an InSPiRe Summary of Work Plans that indicates at least WP1, WP3, and WP4 are using hierarchical models fit with Bayesian methods.

Bill

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Conference on Methodology for Clinical Trials in Small Populations and Rare Diseases
parts:
A lot of people working on Stan work on PK/PD models and applications
to clinical trials that relates to all of their points 1--4. Specifically,
we're working directly on their WP1 and related PK/PD models for clinical
trials up to and including applying meta-analytic methods and hierarchical
models. The outline, if not the details, of their work plan looks like
something we might have written---ours would be a little more Bayesian in
outlook and methodology.

I haven't heard anyone mention they're going to that conference.

- Bob
